resources.string: Security details: a security key changed
Messages are kept on Meldiq\'s servers
Messages, reactions, polls and edits are encrypted on this phone for each member\'s devices. Meldiq\'s server only relays and stores encrypted copies.
Photos, videos, voice messages and files are encrypted on this phone; the server can\'t open them or scan them.
Call audio and video use a key only the participants have. The call screen confirms it once media is decrypting.
Calls are encrypted in transit only
End-to-end call encryption is off on this phone (Settings › Calls), so Meldiq\'s media server could access call audio and video.
You compared safety numbers with %1$s. If their key changes, Meldiq pauses messages and tells you.
Compare safety numbers with %1$s in person or on a call to make sure no one is in between.
Open a member\'s profile to compare safety numbers. Meldiq warns you here if anyone\'s key changes.
Messages with that person are paused until you check their safety number.
Both servers relay encrypted copies only, kept for at most 7 days until delivered.
App updates are posted by Meldiq\'s server
What connected apps post in this channel goes through Meldiq\'s server and is labelled as an app update.
Who is in this conversation, when messages are sent and how large they are. Not their content.
Channels, groups and direct messages with threads, polls and files, on every device you sign in to.
Save messages for later and set reminders. They reach every device you\'re signed in on, even after a restart.
Voice and video calls with screen sharing, and voice channels anyone can drop into any time.
Your account now uses its new email address. Sign in with it and your new password.
Enter the email your account uses now, one of your recovery codes, and the address you want to use from now on.
One of the codes you saved when you set them up. Each code works once.
Enter a different, valid email address
This gets you back into your account. Your encrypted messages still need your encryption recovery key or another signed-in phone.
We sent a 6-digit code to %1$s. Enter it and choose a new password.
Every app signed in to this account will be signed out.
Not set up: create codes in case you lose your email
If you ever lose access to your account\'s email, a recovery code lets you move the account to a new address. Each code works once. Keep them offline, on paper or in a password manager.
These are not your encryption recovery key: they get you into your account, not your encrypted history.
Enter your password to continue. New codes replace any you made before.
They\'re shown only now. Write them down or save them in a password manager, then tap Done.
This server doesn\'t keep reminders yet.
Reminders reach every device you\'re signed in on, even after a restart. What they say is encrypted on your phone.
Pick a time that hasn\'t passed yet.
A reminder this phone can\'t read
Voice room · nobody\'s here yet. Join to open it; nobody gets a ring.
